role: MCP's launcher: main() prepends the MCP client arguments to whatever the command line carries and calls net.minecraft.client.main.Main. It is build scaffolding, not game code.
scope_reason: The oracle is launched through netherite.oracle.Main (oracle/tests/rs.sh and the Makefile targets); Start.main is never run and nothing in the native engine mirrors a launcher.

members.name: main
members.note: Launcher entry; the oracle's entry is netherite.oracle.Main.

members.name: concat
members.note: Array concat helper for main only.

notes: Only used by oracle/Makefile's pristine-diff step, which copies it beside the pristine tree. No behavior of the game depends on it.
